API reference
=============

.. tip::
   **Where are the explanations?**

   For **how to use** the app (including voice), see :doc:`/user_guide`. For **code layout**
   and the speech pipeline, see :doc:`/developer_guide`.

   Open a module page below—for example **budgeting.models** or **budgeting.views**.
   Each **class** and **function** shows a signature, then the **description** taken
   from its Python **docstring** (the text under it in the source file).

   **Module index** (``py-modindex.html``) is only a flat link list of module
   names; it never shows class or function descriptions—use the pages in this
   section instead.
